title: Shadow Maker

serves.summary: The learner puts a material in a beam of light to make a dark, faint or no shadow on the wall, which shows that materials block all, some or almost none of the light.

request.topic: Materials that block light and make shadows
request.objective: Predict the shadow a material makes when it is put in a beam of light: a dark shadow (lets no light through), a faint shadow (lets some through), or no shadow (lets nearly all through). NGSS 1-PS4-3 (SCI001-05-c)

problems.ask: Make a dark shadow on the wall.
problems.goal: Cardboard is in the holder: it lets no light through, so it makes a dark shadow. Clear glass and plastic wrap let nearly all the light through.

problems.ask: Make no shadow on the wall.
problems.goal: Plastic wrap is in the holder: it lets nearly all the light through, so there is no shadow. White card and thin foil block the light; wax paper lets some through.

problems.ask: Make a faint shadow on the wall.
problems.goal: Wax paper is in the holder: it lets some light through, so the shadow is faint. Cardboard makes a dark one; glass and wrap make none.
